description: Java class implementing calculation of the arithmetic mean, including methods for incremental and array-based evaluation, with support for weighted means and copying. Part of Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: Mean
classes.description: Class for computing the arithmetic mean of a set of values, supporting incremental, array, and weighted evaluations, with copying functionality.

methods.name: Mean
methods.description: Default constructor initializing with internal FirstMoment.

methods.name: Mean
methods.description: Copy constructor creating a new instance identical to the original.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Adds a new value to the mean calculation.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the mean calculation.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the mean of a subarray of values.

methods.name: evaluate (weighted)
methods.description: Calculates the weighted mean of a subarray of values.

methods.name: evaluate (unweighted)
methods.description: Calculates the mean of the entire array.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Mean instance.
